description.en: Creates a light (Low) model of the NPC cnNNNN: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(5, _charaName, "dmmy", _npc_no, false, false, false, DEV_MEM_NAME_EVENT). Unless _no_bustup is true, it also creates the character's bust-up picture (CreateBustup) named after the object with "顔" (face) appended.
Name of the new object; the events use the character's name followed by L (light model) or H (detailed model).
NPC number: the model is cnNNNN.
true to skip the bust-up picture.
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: An NPC for a scene (real usage, from ev42010700.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
